description: Run an app's menu bar command through accessibility (AXPress on the item: no pointer, the app need not be frontmost). command is the item title as the app shows it (unique in the menu bar) or a path such as "File > Export > PDF…"; an item that reads disabled is still pressed (closed menus report stale state) and the result says whether anything changed; reports delivery and any sheet or dialog it opened. Menu items under the Apple menu and items whose keyboard shortcut is one of the refused chords need force:true; Quit of the MCP host or of a macOS session process is always refused.
name: mac_menu_command
